mapper.select: SELECT AXIS_TYPE, INDEX_NO, SIZE_PX FROM wo_sheet_size_line WHERE SHEET_SEQ = #{sheetSeq} AND DEL_DATETIME IS NULL ORDER BY AXIS_TYPE, INDEX_NO

insert.foreach: MERGE INTO wo_sheet_size_line T USING (SELECT CAST(#{sheetSeq} AS BIGINT) AS SHEET_SEQ, CAST(#{size.axisType} AS VARCHAR) AS AXIS_TYPE, CAST(#{size.indexNo} AS INT) AS INDEX_NO) S ON (T.SHEET_SEQ = S.SHEET_SEQ AND T.AXIS_TYPE = S.AXIS_TYPE AND T.INDEX_NO = S.INDEX_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SIZE_PX = #{size.sizePx}, MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey}, DEL_DATETIME = NULL, DEL_USER = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SHEET_SEQ, AXIS_TYPE, INDEX_NO, SIZE_PX, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{sheetSeq}, #{size.axisType}, #{size.indexNo}, #{size.sizePx}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} )

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wo_sheet_size_line ( SHEET_SEQ, AXIS_TYPE, INDEX_NO, SIZE_PX, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES
(#{sheetSeq}, #{size.axisType}, #{size.indexNo}, #{size.sizePx}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey})
ON CONFLICT (SHEET_SEQ, AXIS_TYPE, INDEX_NO) DO UPDATE SET SIZE_PX = EXCLUDED.SIZE_PX, MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey}, DEL_DATETIME = NULL, DEL_USER = NULL
